latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Online AI (version 1.0.0).
- Instantly convert up to three JPG product photos into smooth, animated 1080p video clips based on user instructions—no timeline editing or export settings required.
- Seamless cloud rendering pipeline: upload images, describe your desired video, and receive a video download link in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports batch uploads, iterative editing, background music and text overlays, and quick previews.
- Streamlined token/session management with automatic handling of anonymous tokens and session creation.
- Clear error handling and real-time export status updates for user-friendly workflows.
